title: Let gratitude become honest again
summary: This meets the ashamed heart that knows it has received more than it has recognized. The line turns unworthiness into thankful dependence and a plea for Naam.
takeaway: Tell the truth about mercy and receive Naam.
lifeApplication: At the end of the day, name one mercy you passed over. Let gratitude wake up before entitlement does.

source.shortMeaning: Honest gratitude opens the heart to mercy and living Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before sleep, confess one gift you treated as ordinary and thank the Giver.

evidence.coreClaim: Honest gratitude opens the heart to mercy and living Naam.
evidence.turn: Honest gratitude becomes the doorway to mercy and Naam.
